description: Source file implementing the rx::ShaderD3D class, which manages shader compilation, debug info, and workarounds for Direct3D in the ANGLE graphics project.

classes.name: TranslateTaskD3D
classes.description: Encapsulates a task to compile shader source code into HLSL using a specific handle and options.

classes.name: WaitableCompileEventD3D
classes.description: Represents a compile event that can be waited on, including post-translation processing.

methods.name: ShaderD3D
methods.description: Constructor initializing shader with features and extensions, setting options accordingly.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::getDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debug information string for the shader.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::uncompile
methods.description: Resets internal shader state and debug info.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::generateWorkarounds
methods.description: Sets workarounds based on shader usage patterns.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::getUniformRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index for a uniform variable.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::getUniformBlockRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index for a uniform block.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::getShaderStorageBlockRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index for a shader storage block.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::getCompilerOutputType
methods.description: Returns the shader compiler output type.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::useImage2DFunction
methods.description: Checks if a specific image2D function is used in the shader.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::compile
methods.description: Compiles shader source into a shader object, returning a waitable event.

methods.name: ShaderD3D::hasUniform
methods.description: Checks if a uniform variable exists in the shader.
